durable_lessons: Keep Milestone 3 fixture-backed and deterministic; no live data or network acquisition belongs in the verification path.
Represent editorial decisions as append-only events with explicit conflicts and terminal outcomes rather than overwriting prior state.
Preserve the public-read privacy boundary: construct public output from an explicitly publishable projection, never from mutable review tables.
Use ordered, digest-checked forward-only migrations and prove upgrade behavior from the merged Milestone 2 schema.
Re-enforce candidacy, attribution, evidence, and source ownership at every state-changing boundary instead of trusting an earlier stage.

Keep the milestone contained: Milestone 2 touched 26 files and added 4630 lines, including a 1220-line design record, so Milestone 3 should prefer one operator queue and one complete state lifecycle over adjacent search or issue-browsing work.
